title: Calendar
summary: A month grid for choosing one day or a range, shown directly on the page. It is what DatePicker opens, and it pairs with TimeSlots in the booking flow.

demos.title: Single day
demos.note: Arrow keys move by day, PageUp and PageDown by month. Months slide in the direction you move.

demos.title: Range
demos.note: With mode set to range, the first click sets the start and the second the end. Hovering previews the span.
